hero.subtext: Access Hermès, Chanel, Louis Vuitton and more iconic brands in Madrid and Marbella.

howItWorks.title: Simplicity and elegance at every step
howItWorks.subtitle: We have designed an intuitive process that lets you enjoy luxury bags without complications. From selection to delivery, every detail has been carefully considered.

step1.label: Step 01
step1.title: Choose your membership
step1.desc: Select from our membership levels based on your needs and preferences.

step2.label: Step 02
step2.title: Explore our collection
step2.desc: Browse our curated catalogue of bags from the world's most prestigious fashion houses.

step3.label: Step 03
step3.title: Receive and enjoy
step3.desc: Your selection will arrive at your door in exclusive packaging, ready to be enjoyed.

twoModes.title: Two ways to live luxury
twoModes.subtitle: One membership. Two paths to enjoy it. You choose when you book your first bag and can change your mind at any time.

discover.title: Change whenever you want
discover.desc: Try brands, models and styles. Your membership opens the doors to the entire collection so every season you carry something different.
discover.feature1: Full access to the curated catalogue
discover.feature2: Rotation included in your monthly fee

collect.title: Make it yours
collect.desc: Fallen in love? Reserve the bag you never want to let go. Each payment counts toward its purchase. Once you complete its price, it's yours forever.
collect.feature1: The bag is exclusively yours from day one
collect.feature3: Certificate of authenticity from the start

twoModes.note: You decide when you book your first bag. No commitment, no lock-in.

consult.title: Discover your ideal bag
consult.desc: Our team of stylists is available to help you choose the perfect piece for every occasion. Book a free consultation and receive personalised recommendations.

join.title: Start your luxury experience today
join.desc: Become part of an exclusive community of women who value quality, design and sustainability. Our spots are limited to guarantee impeccable service.

memberships.sectionSubtitle: An invitation to experience luxury differently. Each membership is a door to a distinct experience: from discovery to the exceptional. You choose how to step in.
memberships.stylistNote: If you can't find the perfect bag for you, book a personalised appointment with our Fashion Stylist for a fully tailored experience.

petite.desc: Everyday favourites. Borrow a bag every week, no commitment.
petite.longDesc: For those who want to discover the world of luxury bags at their own pace. Activate your monthly membership and buy single passes whenever you want to carry a bag. Ideal for one-off events, weekends or trying before committing to a higher plan.
features: Up to 4 passes per month (1 per week)
Buy passes only when you need them
Essentiel pass: €52 · Signature pass: €99 · Privé pass: €137
petite.forWhom: Ideal for discovering, special occasions or light use.

essentiel.desc: The perfect introduction to the world of luxury bags.
essentiel.longDesc: Your first step into the Semzo universe. Enjoy one premium bag every month, swap it whenever you like and feel the freedom of refreshing your style without accumulating. Designed for members who want to bring luxury into their everyday life with elegance and consistency.
features: Brands such as Coach, Furla, Michael Kors, Tory Burch
essentiel.forWhom: For those who want daily elegance with an accessible touch of luxury.

signature.desc: The experience preferred by our most discerning members.
signature.longDesc: The perfect balance between luxury and exclusivity. Access the most coveted fashion houses with a premium bag each month, personalised attention and priority on new arrivals. The favourite membership of those who already know what they want.
features: Brands such as Prada, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta
signature.forWhom: The most chosen option. For those seeking presence and distinction.

prive.desc: The ultimate experience for true connoisseurs.
prive.longDesc: The most intimate circle of Semzo Privé. Iconic bags from Hermès, Chanel and Louis Vuitton, personal concierge service, private events and early access to rare pieces. Designed for members who value the unique, the exclusive and the irreplaceable.
features: Hermès, Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Goyard, Loewe
prive.forWhom: For connoisseurs who aspire to the exceptional, no compromises.

brand.desc: Access authenticated luxury bags with your Semzo Privé membership. Hermès, Chanel, Louis Vuitton and more iconic brands, no purchase commitment. Your dream wardrobe, one step away.
